      "observations": [
        "Retained complete14-path source study reused. Fresh outcome checks cover the moved MessagePane implementation, template/tag inclusion, startup integration, findbar test and extension target-shape change. Fixed module and needed readiness/command/test consumers were read.",
        "The landing keeps three different browser roles and disables DNS prefetch for message/summary browsers. customElements.whenDefined only guarantees registration; about3Pane later awaits messagePane.isReady before consuming child browsers. Fixed readiness additionally rejects an about:blank child location. The author explicitly says earlier consolidated mutation-observer attempts failed; no universal observer/wait recipe follows.",
        "Reviewer objects to retaining parent references; author chooses the element’s own collapsed-by-splitter class instead of storing parent visibility. Actual #isCollapsed and display guards apply that alternative. Removing duplicate findbar clears on folder switches depends on clear/display paths still hiding competing findbars.",
        "Find and zoom bodies move behind MessagePane methods. The original suffix-consistency request is applied to onFindCommand/onFindAgainCommand/onFindPreviousCommand. visibleMessagePaneBrowser returns the inner single-message content browser, unlike the web or multi-message outer browser.",
        "The original onQueryCompleted callback becomes an arrow to preserve this, and direct load listener resolve replaces an unnecessary wrapper. Conversation custom-element creation uses importESModule at its creation site after reviewer discussion of defineLazyCustomElement; that is a scoped creation/import decision, not a universal import ban. Fixed conversation view later differs, and TODOs still limit find continuation.",
        "Show-single-message carries filtered view indices. MsgsLoaded now bubbles from the element; original extension fallback uses ownerGlobal, fixed code uses documentGlobal. Do not reuse the old window-only target assumption or claim old property spelling remains current.",
        "Template extraction and no extra container display style are applied. Reviewer later questions templates/ placement after acceptance; author defends scanability. This remains disagreement, not a consensus directory rule. The actual retained tree and tag/template/DOM naming families determine scope.",
        "Fresh fixed testMessagePaneFindToolbars directly asserts web→summary→single-message view/findbar visibility and uses actual browser/selection waits. Its later lazy-findbar wrappers differ from original eager findbars. These are direct assertions read, not local passing results. Full Bug1923206 comments0–3 and D228938 full timeline/all21 actual submitted rows read; linked obsolete review/regressions/Try pages stay unopened."
      ],

        "MessagePane zoom and find route through the visible browser’s own contract",
        "MessagePane events carry view indices and extension observers accept either target shape",
        "Message pane names preserve file, tag, class, template and DOM selector roles"
